title: Inner product with a fixed vector preserves local C^{m,alpha} regularity
statement: Let n, l, m be natural numbers, alpha ∈ R, U ⊆ R^n open, w ∈ R^l, and g : R^n -> R^l with IsLocallyHolderCkα m alpha g U. That is, g is C^m on U and for every compact K ⊆ U there is C with ||D^m g(x) - D^m g(y)|| <= C ||x - y||^alpha for all x, y ∈ K, where D^m is iteratedFDeriv R m. Then f(x) := <g(x), w> is C^m on U, and for every compact K ⊆ U there is C' with ||D^m f(x) - D^m f(y)|| <= C' ||x - y||^alpha for all x, y ∈ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (w : Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → IsLocallyHolderCkα m α g U → ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => inner ℝ (g x) w) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => inner ℝ (g z) w) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => inner ℝ (g z) w) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
